review.finding: Two living liches repeatedly ended turns with three actions while four 0-HP vampire mist forms remained unescaped. The vampire ledgers had not advanced beyond rounds 2-3, so narrative Mist Escape prevented encounter victory indefinitely.

policy.mistEscape: A 0-HP vampire is defeated for encounter outcome even while Mist Escape remains pending or mobile.
policy.rejuvenation: A 0-HP lich is defeated for encounter outcome even though Rejuvenation can return it later.
policy.narrativeMechanics: Mist movement and immunity remain available while another active combatant keeps the encounter running.
policy.unchanged: Living hidden, invisible, distant and unreachable hostile combatants still prevent victory.
